Definition: perhaps from G2046 (as a symbol of the female messenger of the pagan deities); a rainbow ("iris"):--rainbow.
BiblicalUsage: A rainbow is the bow around the throne, and John sees it twice. In Revelation 4:3 there is a rainbow round about the throne, in sight like unto an emerald, and in Revelation 10:1 a mighty angel comes down from heaven, clothed with a cloud, and a rainbow is upon his head.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the rainbow around the throne is the same sign as the rainbow after the flood: judgment is real, and mercy rings it round.
RelatedEvents: The Throne Room and the Lamb; The Little Scroll
